key_insight: LLM-generated quantum circuits need layered gatekeeping because many failures are structural, not just incorrect outputs.
engineering_relevance: For practical quantum workflows, evaluation must include physical validity, reference fidelity, and run-to-run consistency before model outputs enter expensive pipelines.
method: Seven-criterion gatekeeper rubric for physical/framework screening.
Circuit fidelity check on H2/STO-3G/Jordan-Wigner/UCCSD outputs against analytical and reference values.
Design entropy metric to measure behavioral consistency across runs.
evidence_signal: Across multiple foundation models in a Materials Project-integrated pipeline, the study identified five distinct failure modes and found that some apparent model errors were actually caused by silent fallback behavior in the evaluation harness.
watch_item: Evaluation infrastructure itself can introduce false failures, so the harness must be audited and treated as part of the trust boundary.
paper_title: Gatekeepers and Hallucinations: A Layered Evaluation Framework for LLM-Driven Quantum Circuit Generation
